// Positive control (#5170): the `unreadable` arm of verdictFromEvidence returns a passing verdict.
import { gateVerdict } from './gate-verdict.cjs';
import { readTextEvidence, verdictFromEvidence } from './gate-evidence.cjs';

export function evaluateFixtureGate(planPath: string) {
  return verdictFromEvidence(readTextEvidence(planPath), {
    found: (text) => gateVerdict('pass', false, { text }),
    none: () => gateVerdict('skip', false, { reason: 'no plan' }),
    unreadable: (reason) => gateVerdict('skip', false, { reason }),
  });
}
